general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp buttons with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
Components MUST use named exports, Pages MUST use default exports.

headings.usage: Use for all page titles, section headers, and large metric displays. Never use Inter.

body.usage: Use for all messaging, profile descriptions, and general UI text. Maintain high readability.

labels.styling: uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[10px] md:text-xs font-bold text-white/50
labels.usage: Use for overlines, small badges, and section categorizations.

visual_enhancers.cards: bg-[#12121A] border border-white/5 rounded-2xl md:rounded-3xl shadow-xl backdrop-blur-sm
visual_enhancers.layering: Use inner shadows (shadow-inner) or subtle top-borders (border-t border-white/10) to create physical depth.
visual_enhancers.textures: Apply subtle noise overlay (opacity-5) to the main background (#0A0A0F) to prevent the void-like pure flat color feel.

layouts_and_grids.rule: DO NOT alter the structural layout, wiring, or functionality. ONLY apply visual spacing enhancements.
layouts_and_grids.spacing: Increase padding within cards organically. If it was p-4, make it p-6 or p-8.
layouts_and_grids.mobile_first: Ensure touch targets are large (min h-12). Images should not exceed 80vh.
layouts_and_grids.alignment: Keep general alignment left-aligned for data and lists. Center align only high-impact single actions or hero text.

motion.buttons: Relative overflow-hidden with pseudo-element shimmer effects on hover.
motion.page_transitions: Subtle fade in (opacity-0 to opacity-100) and slight slide up (translate-y-4 to translate-y-0).

media_and_icons.avatars: Perfect circles, use section-specific colored rings (ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#0A0A0F]) to indicate active stories or online status.
media_and_icons.icons: Use lucide-react. Standardize stroke width to 1.5 for a premium, lightweight aesthetic.
media_and_icons.image_handling: Apply object-cover. Use a dark gradient overlay at the bottom of images where text is layered to ensure contrast.

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary actions use the section's gradient and glow. Secondary actions use bg-white/5 border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10.
component_guidelines.inputs: bg-[#1A1A24] border border-white/5 rounded-xl focus:border-[var(--section-primary)] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[var(--section-primary)] text-white placeholder:text-white/30
component_guidelines.navigation_tabs: Floating pill design. bg-[#12121A]/80 backdrop-blur-md rounded-full border border-white/10. Active tab gets bg-white/10 and text-[var(--section-primary)].
component_guidelines.story_rings: Gradient border around avatars. Uses the specific section's colors.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over gradients/images maintains a 4.5:1 ratio. Use drop-shadows on text if necessary.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings (focus-visible:ring-2).
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media queries for all animations.

instructions_to_main_agent: READ CAREFULLY: You are performing a VISUAL UPGRADE ONLY. Do not change any page routing, component logical structure, or state management.
The app uses .js files, NOT .tsx. Provide all updated component code in .js (JSX).
Users must find everything in the same place. Do not move the location of features.
Inject the section-specific colors (Home=Purple, Lounge=Blue/Cyan, Messages=Indigo, After Dark=Orange/Red, Profile=Stone) contextually based on the page being edited.
Implement the 'data-testid' attributes systematically on all buttons, links, inputs, and major containers (e.g., data-testid='home-story-avatar').
Ensure the background remains #0A0A0F and cards remain #12121A.
Apply the generous spacing philosophy (p-6, p-8) to make the UI breathe.
Enhance the 'premium' feel by removing harsh borders and replacing them with border-white/5 and subtle backdrop blurs.
